title: When the Sigil Turns
author: Vesper Zhou
blurb: Ines Ravensworth, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
